text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging @marta SRE oncall — elevated 5xx + timeout spike (gateway) affecting streaming/paged endpoints. Alert group: streaming-err-rate. Request rate + error rate + client cancels increased since 1768504200.

marta: I’m on it. seeing spike on /v1/stream and paged fanout paths in the gateway. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.example/streams?range=last_15m — backend 502/504s and many client resets.

lee: adding context — we pushed routing change ~10m ago that moved some traffic to routing-group B (quantized models). Could be related.

ryan: quick check — health checks are green. Are the 5xx from workers or gateway? Logs show chunked encoding errors at the gateway layer: 
```
ERROR gateway/stream: write failed: broken pipe: client canceled
WARN gateway: upstream 502 from model-proxy-4 (seqid=...)
```

sam: seeing a contemporaneous spike in client-side connection resets (TCP RSTs) from a handful of IP ranges (cdn-edge-3). Might be aggressive timeouts client-side.

marta: estimate impact — initial scan: ~7% of streaming connections experiencing early EOF or chunked trailer corruption. A few customers reported truncated outputs. Marking Sev2 for now. @sre-lead FYI.

sre-lead: ack. live mitigation plan: 1) disable streaming multiplexing for insecure routes 2) enable non-streaming paged fallback for heavy fanout endpoints 3) temporary increased gateway read timeout to 90s 4) route critical customers to dedicated pool. Who can flip the gateway config?

platform-eng: I can apply gateway flags. Preparing a canary: bump gateway_read_timeout=90s on canary cluster and toggle streaming_threshold=0.8 -> 0.5 to reduce multiplexing.

marta: while platform does canary, let's reduce fanout for paged jobs: turn off parallel fanout for /v1/paged/generate for customers with >10 fanout shards. Add a server-side debounce of 300ms between shard calls.

lee: running curl against canary routing to reproduce: 
```
curl -v --no-buffer 'https://canary-gw.redwood/api/v1/stream?model=redwood-xlarge' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
```
Response shows chunked frames then abrupt close at ~2.1s sometimes.

ryan: captured proxy logs for a failing trace: 
```
[1768504264] client=10.8.0.12 method=POST path=/v1/stream status=499 proto=HTTP/1.1 bytes=0 rt=2.12s upstream_rt=2.10s
[1768504264] downstream EOF before trailer: chunked corruption
```
This suggests clients cancel while backend still writing.

marta: mitigation timeline: platform to deploy canary flags in 2m, if green promote to 100% in 10m. Meanwhile we will open fallback route in routing rules to serve paged = non-stream for affected customers.

platform-eng: canary deployed: gateway_read_timeout=90s on canary, multiplexing throttle lowered. Monitoring.

marta: early signal — 1m after canary: 5xx rate down ~40% on canary, client cancels reduced. Good sign.

pagerduty-bot: Incident annotated: P-1768504321. Current incident owner: marta. Escalation step: notify AE for any affected paid customers.

sam: applied IP-based hold on cdn-edge-3 for additional logging — we’re seeing spikes in retries from cdn-edge-3 that look like partial data retransmits. I've asked CDN partner for behind-the-scenes.

lee: flipping fallback for high-fanout tenant `acme-corp` to paged/non-stream now. 

marta: customer-impact note: two enterprise customers reported truncated streaming outputs; no data loss of persisted outputs but UX degraded. Logging customer IDs to PSR: ACME-123, NOVA-77. Support notified.

platform-eng: promoting canary to 50% now. No obvious regressions.

ryan: adding a temporary Nginx proxy tweak on gateway nodes to disable chunked trailer on upstream proxies for problematic routes (falls back to Content-Length). Deploying in 1m.

marta: after Nginx tweak + fallback for heavy fanout + increased read timeout — system 5xx rate back to baseline within 8m. Client cancels down to normal.

sre-lead: good job. Keep monitoring 30m. Please collect traces for postmortem. Key action items for post-incident:
- root-cause: investigate routing change + cdn-edge interplay
- add more robust chunked frame handling and trailer validation in gateway runtime
- add automatic fallback rule for high-fanout customers when client cancel rate > 3%
- improve customer-facing incident templates for truncated streams

marta: assigning owners: platform-eng -> canary/timeout change (done), eng-runtime -> chunked handling (ryan + lee), oncall -> follow up logs and retention (marta), support -> customer comms (sam).

platform-eng: will open PR for permanent config toggles and a safer rollout plan.

ryan: logging note — captured sample payloads and proxy traces stored at s3://redwood-incident/1768504321/traces.zip.

sam: support sent initial message to affected customers: short apology, workaround (paged fallback), estimated full fix ETA 3 days.

marta: closing live mitigation phase. Monitoring for 30m then handoff to follow-up. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

sre-lead: please file a postmortem doc in /incidents/postmortems with timeline and RCA within 72h.

marta: ack. handoff to follow-up owners.

pagerduty-bot: Incident P-1768504321 status: Mitigated -> monitoring.

platform-eng: final note — consider deprecating streaming multiplex on routing-group B until runtime fix lands.

marta: noted. End thread.
